title.value: Watch item prices and email on drops

introduction.value: A commenter set up a ChatGPT price watch on items they want and gets an email only when the price drops.

method.value: The commenter set up a recurring ChatGPT task using the schedule tool rather than separate watches for each item. They ask it to check all US/web stores for an item, notify only when it falls to a target price, and optionally connect a mail app so the alert is emailed; another commenter says they bundle multiple home-decor items into one watch.

outcome.value: They describe it as one of the boring setups that actually sticks because it only messages on a real drop. The thread gives no purchase savings or success-rate numbers, and notes plan limits on how many scheduled checks you can have.

notes.value: One practical catch: free and Plus plans were said to top out at hourly checks, with a cap on the number of scheduled watches, so grouping items into one task helps.

source_text.body:
Watch item prices and email on drops
A commenter set up a ChatGPT price watch on items they want and gets an email only when the price drops.
Done with
GA
ChatGPT Agent
What they did
The commenter set up a recurring ChatGPT task using the schedule tool rather than separate watches for each item. They ask it to check all US/web stores for an item, notify only when it falls to a target price, and optionally connect a mail app so the alert is emailed; another commenter says they bundle multiple home-decor items into one watch.
How it went
They describe it as one of the boring setups that actually sticks because it only messages on a real drop. The thread gives no purchase savings or success-rate numbers, and notes plan limits on how many scheduled checks you can have.
Worth knowing
One practical catch: free and Plus plans were said to top out at hourly checks, with a cap on the number of scheduled watches, so grouping items into one task helps.
Try it yourself
with
ChatGPT Agent
Copy prompt
Set up a recurring price watch on these items: [product links or names] at [retailers]. Check [daily/weekly] and email me at [email] only when the price drops below [target price] or falls by more than [percent]. Don't buy anything; just tell me what you set up and confirm the first price you found for each item.
Original source: https://www.reddit.com/r/ChatGPT/comments/1wqm0j0/what_are_the_crazy_mind_blowing_ways_of_using
